## TL;DR

Durable handoff-status rows that outlive their finalization no longer block Move to done on review tasks. Reconciliation on API read and watchdog ticks persists `superseded` when nothing owns the slot, emits `handoff:superseded` for open boards, and returns `stale: true` for overdue live slots. The UI treats stale running records as non-blocking for landability, polls handoff status on review cards, and labels long checks with “stale”.

## Work and rationale

Review pass 1 found recovery finalization being superseded mid-check, CLI omitting `superseded`, and review cards never refreshing reconciled state. Follow-up work added `handoffProcessLive` (including post-handoff checkpoint recovery), SSE on supersede, review-card polling, and `handoffInFlight` / `reviewChecksRunning` exemptions for `stale`. Shots use `card:checksProgress` and `card:reviewLandableReady` fixtures with valid selectors.

## Approaches tried

Client-only filtering was rejected in favor of server-side reconcile-and-persist so CLI and UI share one truth. Shots initially targeted a non-existent `.tc-status-line`; they now highlight the check progress block and review hint line.

## Challenges and blockers

Handoff verify failed on the bad shot selector; fixed fixture stale flags and redeclared shots. No live repro of the original #1080 incident in this session.

## Key learnings

Any durable `running` gate must reconcile against slot ownership and task status on read, not only at pipeline exit, and supersede events need SSE so review-column cards refresh without opening the drawer.
